town_description: Shillong is the capital of Meghalaya in the East Khasi Hills district, a hill station at about 1,496 m known as the 'Scotland of the East'. It was the capital of undivided Assam until 1972 and remains the state's administrative, educational and cultural hub, with a predominantly Khasi tribal population alongside Bengali, Nepali, Assamese and other communities (verify). The primary referent used here lies on Keating Road in the Secretariat Hills area of central Shillong (coordinates approximate - Keating Road street centroid; verify).

travel.railway: Guwahati railway station is the nearest major railhead (approx. 100 km by road; verify); onward by taxi or bus via NH-6.
travel.road: Shillong is well connected by road to Guwahati (approx. 3-4 hours via NH-6; verify); within the city, local taxis and shared cabs serve all localities (verify).
